g.title: Sensors & hardware / Cameras: missing
Sensors & hardware / Touchscreen: ready
Sensors & hardware / Motion sensors (SLPI): ready
Sensors & hardware / Buttons: ready
Sensors & hardware / Vibration: ready
Sensors & hardware / Light / proximity: ready - proximity near level from the factory calibration
Sensors & hardware / Fingerprint: missing
Sensors & hardware / AirTriggers: missing
Sensors & hardware / RGB logo LED: partial / not fully integrated

Sensors & hardware / Hardware video decode/encode: partial / not fully integrated - k115 RAM trials 2026-10-02: with a real EOS buffer H.264 and HEVC 1080p decode 300/300 bit-exact, GStreamer OK, 5 min idle OK (runtime PM auto); dummy EOS address crashed the firmware; VP9 session error (no SECURE_SESSION=0); H.264 encode hard-hung the SoC at session start (boots B and D; B was first misread as an idle hang with pinned runtime PM). k116 (0163-0168: SM8350 OEM platform data with SECURE_SESSION=0, real EOS default, stock Iris2 power off/on order with real OPP release, encoder/VP9 behind load-time switches, gen1 property packet sizing, compliance and robustness fixes, encoder bring-up markers) built as RAM wrappers main-k116-d15-261002a/b/c (+d for a later encoder boot), not installed; plan in docs/hardware/video.md. CPU baseline 1080p: H.264 9.8x, HEVC 7.6x, VP9 8.4x realtime
Connectivity / Wi-Fi: partial / not fully integrated - stable MAC/IP since 2026-09-29; 11 s reconnect after wake
Connectivity / Cellular modem: missing - out of scope
Connectivity / Bluetooth: ready
Connectivity / Bluetooth headset mic (HFP): missing
Connectivity / Tailscale: ready - one daemon per host; ramdisk tailscaled only as a fallback
Connectivity / Hotspot: needs a test
Connectivity / GPS: missing
Connectivity / NFC: missing
Display & shell / AMOLED panel: ready - 1080x2448 at 60 Hz
Display & shell / Phosh: needs a test - hotplug crash fixes installed (phosh 0.57.0-1.3, phoc 0.57.0-1.2), no crash since 2026-09-30 00:00; plug/unplug stress test pending
Display & shell / Brightness: partial / not fully integrated - about 4 real steps
Display & shell / High refresh rate: missing - 60 Hz only
Display & shell / Lock screen & PIN: ready

Display & shell / Alternative phone shells (GNOME Mobile, Plasma Mobile): ready - 2026-10-01: both tried on the phone and rejected by the user; Phosh + GNOME desktop mode stays. GNOME Mobile: opt-in packages, rog5-shell selector and watchdog (fell back to a locked Phosh correctly), mutter-mobile 50.5-1.1 drops the fork's dma-buf stride override (it killed Xwayland/Steam); packages kept in packages/gnome-mobile. Plasma Mobile 6.7.5: ran, lock-on-start not honoured, removed (test-results/2026-10-01-kde-plasma-trial.md)
Display & shell / App launch feedback: ready - Chromium desktop file fixed; Firefox splash still times out

Boot & updates / Signed boot chain: ready - slot-B wrapper, try-once selector, signed fallback safe-k111-d10 (rehearsed 2026-10-01; safe-r8 rehearsed 2026-09-30, kept on p24); installer never unlinks on p24 and proves the ro remount (cc090781); bundles built by rog5-make-bundle.py, names main|safe-kNNN-dN-YYMMDDx
Boot & updates / Kernel updates: ready - file writes on p24, automatic fallback

Boot & updates / Unattended package updates: needs a test - reboots only when idle (no remote client, no sound, 01-06 window); snapshots exclude user data (~6 GB); v2 restore passed fault injection and is in both bundles (safe-r8), not yet a real rollback
Boot & updates / Boot splash: needs a test - r187 keeps the bootloader logo until phoc (0107/0108); needs a visual check
Boot & updates / Boot time: partial / not fully integrated - ~57 s to multi-user on r205 (21 s kernel + initramfs, 35 s userspace)
Boot & updates / Reboot to fastboot: missing - reboot argument ignored by the shutdown script

External display / DP alt mode (native DP, HBR2): ready - native DP monitors at HBR2 (0110), MSI 491C 3840x1080@60 with keyboard/mouse behind its hub; first-enable blue screen fixed at the root (0130-0135)

External display / GNOME desktop mode: partial / not fully integrated - event-driven, fail-closed switcher; the user keeps mode manual (2026-10-01; auto needs a supervised lock test); apps close on a switch but rog5-session-carry quits them cleanly and reopens them in the other session (2026-10-01; first live switch with apps pending)

External display / 4-lane DP: ready - 4 x HBR2/HBR in both orientations; boot with the monitor attached comes up by itself (rog5-usb-reconnect: UCSI data-role kick only when the ADSP sent no DP notification; hub re-init after DP); HDMI hub on pin D at 2 lanes

External display / 5120x1440, 100 Hz, HBR3: partial / not fully integrated - halved clock check is the default (0139); 8 bpc floor (0147) hides 5120x1440@100; GNOME offers 5120x1440@60, 3840x1080@60/100/144, 2560x1440@60/120 and switches modes (user, 2026-10-01); 3840x1080@144 only briefly tested; HBR3 opt-in untested

External display / DP link power policy: ready - 0145 dp_link_policy=1: 3840x1080@60 on 4 x HBR, -48 +- 30 mW vs 4 x HBR2 (MMCX SVS instead of SVS_L1), measured on the MSI (test-results/2026-09-30-dp-link-policy-power.md)
External display / No DPU clock pin: ready - GNOME without the 460 MHz pin: 5/5 clean first enables on r104 (ca10325b)
External display / Touchscreen as touchpad: ready
External display / HDMI converters above HBR: missing - the hub HDMI PCON stays dark at HBR2; converters capped at HBR (1080p60); 0119/0134 opt-in experiments
External display / HDR: missing - later: port of stock VSC/HDR-metadata SDPs

Power / Deep standby (CX/DDR collapse): missing - ~79 mA suspended, no CX/DDR collapse; bisect kit requalified on DTB r9 (3de9e285): likely a DDR vote from another RPMh master (ADSP); trials need the phone unplugged

Power / Charging & limits: ready - rog5-charge-policy: 70-80 % limit with bypass at the limit, bypass in performance mode or when hot; below-full bypass with a PD charger untested; via the monitor hub: 9 V contract, input capped at 1.4 A (~12.5 W) by the ADSP (the hub offers 9 V 2.45 A, no PPS; 15/20 V unusable by the phone)
Power / Suspend (s2idle): ready - sleep policy stays awake for audio playback, sleep inhibitors and charger-attached force-discharge (10cc4116); s2idle with a bottom-port stick PASS on k111
Power / Battery standby measurement: needs a test - needs the phone unplugged

Power / Idle background wakeups: partial / not fully integrated - desktop-mode switcher event-driven (~0.1 % CPU); sleep policy polls every 5 s; k111: USB DDR vote follows attached devices (0148) and PM8350C L11 off (d10) — A/B with rog5-idle-power-sample pending

Power / Memory (zram swap): ready - 5.2 GiB zram zstd, MGLRU, THP madvise; d13 memslim (590 MiB of unused carve-outs) + k113 SWIOTLB 4 MiB (60 MiB): MemTotal 11.0 GiB, up from 10.4 GiB (trials 2026-10-01)
Power / Instruction-fetch aborts (SIGBUS): needs a test - memx no-map 64 MiB at 0x34a000000 in d9/d10 and safe-r8 + rog5-sea-retire; no new aborts seen since; Dota 2 under FEX to retest
Performance / CPU: ready - GB6 1580/4191 (above Android)
Performance / GPU (Vulkan/GL): ready - GB6 Vulkan 4670 normal, 5405 performance mode; Turnip 8-bit storage for DXVK 3 (vulkan-freedreno 26.2.3-1.1, held)
Performance / Thermal protection: ready - skin + junction trips, 65 C shutdown
Performance / Performance mode: partial / not fully integrated - rog5-perf-mode auto, perf_on_power=always on the phone (performance trips on any external power); no toggle in Phosh yet
Performance / System monitor (Resources): ready
USB / Side port host + hubs: ready - survives suspend (0105); monitor hub USB comes up at boot via reconnect retries
USB / Replug recovery (-71): partial / not fully integrated - side port: rog5-usb-reconnect re-initialises the controller; kernel fix (0142 retries / 0143 session override) needs the one-replug test
USB / Charging via hub: ready

USB / Bottom port (USB 2.0 host): ready - stage B (RT1715 + TCPM): automatic 5 V on attach incl. a stick present at boot (0144 PDC edge/level, 0146 TCPM reset-exit CC read); survives s2idle with data intact (2026-10-01); detach power not measured
USB / USB gadget (network to a PC): ready
USB / USB drives (Files/Disks): ready - udisks with a polkit guard for the internal UFS; configured disks mounted at boot by rog5-usb-storage (28 s on r205); unconfigured sticks via gvfs after login
USB / USB 3 on the side port: missing - SuperSpeed not verified; the monitor hub runs at USB 2.0 (480M) next to DP
Audio / Speakers: ready - full strength via PipeWire S16LE; 0 dB only behind a verified protection DSP, -12 dB otherwise (b509257c)
Audio / Speaker protection DSP: ready - both amps with factory calibration; robustness PASS on k111: 20 start/stops + 5 min, 0 amp errors (2026-10-01)
Audio / 24-bit playback: needs a test - 0125-0127 (V4 Q23 front end) in r108; PipeWire stays S16LE until a loudness A/B
Audio / Microphones: ready
Audio / Earpiece: missing
Audio / 3.5 mm jack: missing
Audio / Bluetooth audio: needs a test
Audio / Audio over DP: missing
Server / SSH (keys only): ready
Server / 128 GiB persistent root: ready - overlay loop with direct I/O (4 KiB blocks)
Server / Firewall (nftables): ready
Server / Hardware watchdog: ready
Server / Journal retention: ready - 1 GB cap; excluded from update snapshots

Apps / Steam (native arm64): partial / not fully integrated - title-bar drag and resize via an LD_PRELOAD shim (c75efe81); x86 games through FEX (Half-Life ran); BioShock runs on x86 Proton 9 (DXVK 2.5.1) under FEX; patched x86_64+i686 FEX Turnip for DXVK 3 built and passed s8test on the A660 (packages/mesa-fex), install pending; Dota 2 retest pending
Apps / Browsers: ready - Firefox and Chromium
